task_completion.description: Agent runs the baseline simulation using the Bologna Acosta scenario to gather initial traffic data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal commands showing 'sumo' or 'sumo-gui' execution with the /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/run.sumocfg file.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies the five standard edges with the highest vehicle counts from the baseline output.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or text editor showing the analysis of edge data (e.g., sorting by 'entered' or 'sampledSeconds') to find the top 5 edges.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the pricing_weights.xml file applying travel time penalties to the identified edges.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing the content of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/pricing_weights.xml with the 5 identified Edge IDs and increased weight/traveltime values.

task_completion.description: Agent generates alternative routes using the weight file (typically via duarouter).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command showing 'duarouter' execution referencing the weight file and the original route file.

task_completion.description: Agent runs a second simulation using the newly generated priced routes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command or SUMO-GUI showing a simulation run using the updated route file or configuration.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the final report with the specific 6-line format and CSV data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing /home/ga/SUMO_Output/pricing_report.txt with the header 'EdgeID, BeforeVolume, AfterVolume' followed by exactly 5 lines of data.

integrity.description: Verify the agent didn't just write the report without performing simulations.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent must show terminal commands for running SUMO and processing XML files before the report file is created.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the specific paths requested in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show paths like /home/ga/SUMO_Output/pricing_weights.xml and /home/ga/SUMO_Output/pricing_report.txt being used in commands.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually parsed the XML output rather than guessing edge IDs.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent opening or grep-ing the baseline edge data XML file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The baseline simulation should identify edge '204a[0]' (approx 2733 vehicles) and '43[0]' among the top 5 busiest edges. The final report at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/pricing_report.txt must have exactly 6 lines: a header 'EdgeID, BeforeVolume, AfterVolume' and 5 data lines. The 'AfterVolume' for the targeted edges should generally be lower than 'BeforeVolume' due to the travel time penalty applied in pricing_weights.xml.
